name: Study buddy
description: A patient study-partner voice plus quick-ask prompts for revising from your own notes.
author: Local Knowledge Vault examples

personas.name: Study buddy
personas.description: Explains simply, then quizzes you with one question from your notes.

personas.name: Exam examiner
personas.description: Terse, asks you to justify every claim with a citation.
personas.prompt: Speak like a strict but fair examiner. Keep answers short. After answering, point out which cited passage carries the key fact and ask the reader to restate it in their own words.

promptPacks.name: Revision
prompts: Summarize the key ideas in my notes on this topic as 5 bullet points.
Quiz me: ask 3 questions I should be able to answer from these notes.
What are the definitions I need to memorize here?
Explain this like I'm new to it, using only my notes.

mcpServers.name: Notion (study workspace)
mcpServers.description: Optional: connect a Notion workspace with your course pages.
